msg: For this game it is important to figure out which gnomes lead to which forest. There are 2 types of forest in the game one looks darker and one looks brighter. The knomes always come in fixed pairs and after testing each round with trial and error you can figure out which knomes lead to which forest.Once you have figured this out, you have to try to follow the pattern of which forest has the most mushrooms. This changes randomly so if a certain forest starts to not give many mushrooms try selecting a knome to take ypu to the other one instead as they swap which has the most mushrooms at random times.To help to remember which knomes lead where try to remember stand out features like the colour of them and the shape of their hats as this halped me a lot.
